from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """One court document with its title and cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as referenced")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) stated in the document, e.g. '贪污罪', '受贿罪', '行政诉讼纠纷', etc.")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="General case category: 刑事, 民事, 行政")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
